tools.name: manychat_get_page_info
tools.description: Get the connected ManyChat page (the Facebook or Instagram page the key belongs to): id, name and basic settings. A good first call to confirm the connection. GET /fb/page/getInfo.

tools.name: manychat_list_tags
tools.description: List all tags on the page with their ids. Use the ids with the add and remove tag tools. GET /fb/page/getTags.

tools.name: manychat_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the subscriber custom fields on the page with their ids and types. GET /fb/page/getCustomFields.

tools.name: manychat_list_flows
tools.description: List the automations (flows) and their folders. Use a flow's ns with manychat_send_flow. GET /fb/page/getFlows.

tools.name: manychat_list_bot_fields
tools.description: List the page-level bot fields (values shared by all subscribers) with their ids. GET /fb/page/getBotFields.

tools.name: manychat_get_subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber (contact) by id: name, channel, tags, custom field values and subscription status. GET /fb/subscriber/getInfo.

tools.name: manychat_get_subscriber_by_user_ref
tools.description: Get one subscriber by its user ref (the channel user id, for example a Messenger user ref). GET /fb/subscriber/getInfoByUserRef.

tools.name: manychat_find_subscribers_by_name
tools.description: Find up to 100 subscribers whose name matches. Use the ids with the other subscriber tools. GET /fb/subscriber/findByName.

tools.name: manychat_find_subscribers_by_custom_field
tools.description: Find up to 100 subscribers whose custom field equals a value. GET /fb/subscriber/findByCustomField.

tools.name: manychat_find_subscriber_by_system_field
tools.description: Find one subscriber by its email or phone number (give at least one). GET /fb/subscriber/findBySystemField.

tools.name: manychat_create_tag
tools.description: Create a new tag on the page. Fails if a tag with that name exists. POST /fb/page/createTag.

tools.name: manychat_add_tag_to_subscriber
tools.description: Add a tag to one subscriber. Adding a tag twice has no extra effect. POST /fb/subscriber/addTag.

tools.name: manychat_remove_tag_from_subscriber
tools.description: Remove a tag from one subscriber. POST /fb/subscriber/removeTag.

tools.name: manychat_set_custom_field
tools.description: Set one custom field value on one subscriber. POST /fb/subscriber/setCustomField.

tools.name: manychat_send_flow
tools.description: Start one automation (flow) for one subscriber. The subscriber then receives the flow's real messages. Use manychat_list_flows for the flow ns. POST /fb/sending/sendFlow.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: manychat_find_subscriber_by_system_field · Private data: manychat_get_subscriber · Public sink: manychat_find_subscriber_by_system_field, manychat_create_tag, manychat_add_tag_to_subscriber, manychat_remove_tag_from_subscriber, manychat_set_custom_field, manychat_send_flow · Destructive: manychat_list_tags, manychat_remove_tag_from_subscriber.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: manychat_find_subscriber_by_system_field · Private data: manychat_get_subscriber · Public sink: manychat_find_subscriber_by_system_field, manychat_create_tag, manychat_add_tag_to_subscriber, manychat_remove_tag_from_subscriber, manychat_set_custom_field, manychat_send_flow · Destructive: manychat_list_tags, manychat_remove_tag_from_subscriber

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
